The Anvils

The Anvil Mountains rise like crowned titans at the world's crown, cradling the enduring soul of the Dunzenkell nation. Wrought from the bones of the northern range, their peaks cradle the memory of those first dwarvish heroes who carved their names into stone. It was within these frost-bound halls that the foundations of civilization were laid, and from their carved arteries flow the waters that still nourish the bloodlines of miners, artisans, warriors, and kin.
